purpose: Append-only, idempotent index of Cloud operation evidence and exact Candidate identity.
machineBoundary: Evidence lookup and export only; source receipts and service state remain owned by their originating service.

lifecycle.removalCondition: Replace only with a newer current contract for the same evidence-index boundary.

nonOwnership: Control Plane account, Workspace, or operation state
Fabric provider resources or provider state
Sub2API wallet, keys, or usage state
Instance deployment, production, or rollback authority

entry.redactedLinkRule: HTTP(S) URL without userinfo, query, or fragment, or an opaque locator without whitespace
entry.immutableFields: Every entry is append-only; corrections append a new entry with a new idempotency identity.
entry.identity: operationId and exact candidateSha/candidateTree/imageDigest are stored as owner-supplied opaque references.
entry.idempotency: Same Idempotency-Key with the same request projection replays the original entry; a different projection is a conflict.

api.exportSemantics: schemaVersion 1 with stable ordering and no Idempotency-Key
